positioning.title: Positioning
positioning.history: Place elements at exact coordinates using position: static | relative | absolute | fixed | sticky. Essential for overlays, tooltips, and precise layouts.
positioning.code:
Absolutely positioned

Container with an absolutely positioned badge.
positioning.quiz: Which CSS property family places elements at exact coordinates like top/left?

z-index.title: z-index
z-index.history: Controls stacking order of positioned elements. Higher z-index appears above lower ones within the same stacking context.
z-index.quiz: Which property controls which element appears on top?

display.title: display
display.history: Defines how an element participates in layout: block, inline, inline-block, none, flex, grid, inline-grid, etc.
display.code:
Flex item 1
Flex item 2
display.quiz: Which property sets an element's layout behavior like block, inline, flex, or grid?

visibility.title: visibility
visibility.history: Show or hide an element while preserving its layout space. visibility: hidden keeps the box but hides content.
visibility.code:
Visible box
Hidden but space reserved
visibility.quiz: Which property hides an element but keeps its layout space?

overflow.title: overflow
overflow.history: Controls what happens when content exceeds its container: visible, hidden, scroll, auto. Use overflow-x / overflow-y for axes.
overflow.code: Scrollable content
overflow.quiz: Which property controls behavior when content overflows a box?

object-fit-object-position.title: object-fit / object-position
object-fit-object-position.history: Control how replaced elements (images, videos) fill their container: cover, contain, fill, none, scale-down; object-position sets focal point.
object-fit-object-position.quiz: Which properties control how images fit and where they are positioned inside a container?

pointer-events.title: pointer-events
pointer-events.history: Enable or disable mouse/touch interactions on an element. pointer-events: none lets events pass through to elements underneath.
pointer-events.quiz: Which property disables mouse/touch interactions on an element?

user-select.title: user-select
user-select.history: Control whether text can be selected by the user. Useful for UI controls where selection is undesirable.
user-select.code: You cannot select this text.
user-select.quiz: Which property prevents text selection by the user?

isolation.title: isolation
isolation.history: Creates a new stacking context so blend modes and z-index behave predictably. Useful when using mix-blend-mode or complex overlays.
isolation.quiz: Which property creates a new stacking context for blend modes?

writing-mode-direction.title: writing-mode / direction
writing-mode-direction.history: Support for vertical text and right-to-left scripts. writing-mode controls flow (horizontal-tb, vertical-rl, vertical-lr); direction sets inline direction (ltr/rtl).
writing-mode-direction.code: Vertical text example
writing-mode-direction.quiz: Which properties enable vertical text and RTL support?

contain-will-change.title: contain / will-change
contain-will-change.history: contain limits what the browser must consider for an element (layout, paint, size) improving performance; will-change hints upcoming changes (transform, opacity) to optimize rendering.
contain-will-change.code: Hover me (will-change)
contain-will-change.quiz: Which properties help with performance by limiting scope and hinting upcoming changes?

scroll-snap.title: scroll-snap
scroll-snap.history: Create smooth snapping behavior for scroll containers (carousels, slides). Use scroll-snap-type on container and scroll-snap-align on children.
scroll-snap.code:
1
2
3
scroll-snap.quiz: Which feature enables snapping behavior for scrollable carousels?

aspect-ratio.title: aspect-ratio
aspect-ratio.history: Maintain a fixed width-to-height ratio for elements, useful for responsive media and cards without extra wrappers.
aspect-ratio.quiz: Which property keeps an element's width/height ratio fixed?

resize.title: resize
resize.history: Allow users to resize elements (usually textareas) with the mouse: none, both, horizontal, vertical. Works when overflow is not visible.
resize.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>resize Example</title>
<style>
  textarea { width:320px; height:120px; resize: both; padding:8px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <textarea>Drag to resize me</textarea>
</body>
</html>
resize.quiz: Which property enables user drag-resize of an element?

touch-action.title: touch-action
touch-action.history: Control how touch gestures are handled (pan-x, pan-y, none, manipulation). Important for custom gesture handling and preventing browser defaults.
touch-action.code: Touch horizontally to pan
touch-action.quiz: Which property controls how touch gestures are interpreted by the browser?

typography-control.title: Typography Control
typography-control.history: Properties like line-height, letter-spacing, word-spacing, and text-indent improve readability and spacing of text.
typography-control.code: Line-height, letter-spacing, word-spacing and text-indent improve readability and typographic rhythm.
typography-control.quiz: Which properties control line spacing and letter/word spacing?

font-management.title: Font Management
font-management.history: Advanced font features: font-variant, font-feature-settings, font-kerning allow control over ligatures, numeric styles, and kerning.
font-management.code: Advanced font rendering with font-feature-settings and font-variant.
font-management.quiz: Which properties enable advanced font rendering like ligatures and kerning?

visibility-interaction.title: Visibility & Interaction Utilities
visibility-interaction.history: Group of properties (visibility, pointer-events, user-select, caret-color) to control how users interact with content and how it's presented.
visibility-interaction.code:
Cannot select this text
Hidden text (space reserved)
This element ignores pointer events
visibility-interaction.quiz: Which properties control selection, pointer interaction, and caret color?

scroll-behavior.title: Scroll Behavior
scroll-behavior.history: scroll-behavior, scroll-margin, and scroll-padding control smooth scrolling and alignment for in-page navigation and focus management.
scroll-behavior.code:
Go to section 2

Section 1

Section 2
scroll-behavior.quiz: Which property enables smooth in-page scrolling?

resize-overflow.title: Resize & Overflow Utilities
resize-overflow.history: Control resizing and overflow behavior with resize, overflow-x/y, overflow-wrap, and word-break to handle long content gracefully.
resize-overflow.code: VeryLongWordWithoutSpacesThatWillBreakBecauseOf overflow-wrap and word-break.
resize-overflow.quiz: Which properties help control overflow and user resizing?

touch-gesture.title: Touch & Gesture
touch-gesture.history: touch-action and -webkit-tap-highlight-color help manage mobile gestures and visual tap feedback for better touch UX.
touch-gesture.code: Touch area (pan-x)
touch-gesture.quiz: Which properties control mobile gesture handling and tap highlight?

isolation-context.title: Isolation & Context
isolation-context.history: Use isolation, z-index, contain, and will-change to manage stacking contexts and performance for complex UIs.
isolation-context.code: Isolated stacking context with containment
isolation-context.quiz: Which properties help manage stacking context and performance?

writing-modes-support.title: Writing Modes Support
writing-modes-support.history: writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation enable RTL and vertical text support for internationalization and creative layouts.
writing-modes-support.code: 垂直
writing-modes-support.quiz: Which properties enable RTL and vertical text?

counter-content.title: Counter & Content
counter-content.history: counter-reset, counter-increment, and content allow custom numbering and generated content for lists, steps, and UI counters.
counter-content.code:
1. First
  2. Second
  3. Third
counter-content.quiz: Which properties create custom numbered lists and generated content?

custom-properties.title: Custom Properties (CSS variables)
custom-properties.history: Define reusable values with --var-name and use them with var(). Great for theming and DRY CSS.
custom-properties.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>CSS Variables</title>
<style>
  :root { --brand: #2563eb; --pad: 12px; }
  .btn { background:var(--brand); color:#fff; padding:var(--pad); border-radius:8px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="btn">Themed button</button>
</body>
</html>
custom-properties.quiz: Which syntax defines reusable CSS variables?

environment-units.title: Environment Units
environment-units.history: env(safe-area-inset-*) exposes device safe-area insets (notch, rounded corners) for proper spacing on mobile devices.
environment-units.code: Content padded for safe area
environment-units.quiz: Which function provides safe-area insets for devices with notches?

container-queries.title: Container Queries
container-queries.history: Style components based on their container size using @container, container-type, and container-name — enables component-level responsiveness.
container-queries.code:
A
B
C
container-queries.quiz: Which feature allows styling based on parent container size?

view-transitions.title: View Transitions (2025)
view-transitions.history: View transitions provide page-level transitions without heavy JS using view-transition-name and @view-transition. Support is emerging.
view-transitions.code: Page content for view transitions (browser support required)
view-transitions.quiz: Which new feature enables page transitions without heavy JavaScript?

anchor-positioning.title: Anchor Positioning (New)
anchor-positioning.history: Position elements relative to another element using anchor-name and position-anchor — useful for tooltips/popovers with precise placement.
anchor-positioning.code: Tooltip anchored to button (spec support required)
anchor-positioning.quiz: Which experimental feature positions elements relative to another element?

motion-path.title: Motion Path
motion-path.history: Animate elements along custom paths using offset-path, offset-distance, and offset-rotate for complex motion effects.
motion-path.quiz: Which properties animate an element along a custom path?

color-levels.title: Color Level 4/5
color-levels.history: New color spaces (Lab, LCH, HWB) and functions enable perceptually uniform color control and smoother color transitions for design systems.
color-levels.quiz: Which new color specs provide perceptual color control like LCH and HWB?
